plugin.name: Framework Only (Recommended)
plugin.description: Silent environmental framework. The API and climate estimates are fully functional, but no HUD notifications appear. You can change this anytime in SKSE\Plugins\Aetherclime\config.json: set hud.mode to off, minimal, detailed, or debug. Reinstalling with a preset can overwrite your customized config; back it up first.

plugin.name: Minimal HUD (Optional)
plugin.description: Show concise seasonal and temperature status messages on eligible environment changes (90-second cooldown, heartbeat disabled). Change your mind anytime in SKSE\Plugins\Aetherclime\config.json by editing hud.mode. Re-running the installer can overwrite customized settings; back up config.json before reinstalling.
